objective: Prevent strategically aligned learning courses from being converted into player quests that mismatch the learner's verified baseline, prerequisites, or instruction/interface language; route the corrected German A0 quest to the official Russian DW surface.

roles_before.role: Owns verified current learning baseline and execution evidence, including German A0.
Supplies long-horizon learning direction without owning current competence or exact entry step.
Requires current owner evidence before scored quest creation and calibrates effort/friction/complexity/stakes.
Provides the direct player-facing execution link for the current German learning quest.
Remains the sole mutable owner of derived quest state.
Preserves at most one execution focus and does not allow engineering changes to choose unrelated strategic direction.

role_dispositions.destination: domains/learning.md remains authoritative for German A0 baseline and actual learning evidence.
XMind remains a read-only strategic prior; alignment no longer substitutes for entry-step suitability.
QUEST_DIFFICULTY_SPEC.md keeps existing scoring and adds a narrow pre-scoring learning execution-fit gate.
player-utility.js maps the corrected A0 quest to the official Russian-localized DW Hallo page instead of the cancelled English-route quest.
Neon/PostgreSQL system_events remains the only mutable derived-state owner.
QUEST_FOCUS_SPEC.md remains unchanged; replacing the sole bad open quest does not create a second focus mechanism.

capability_probes.assertion: Non-learning Quest v2 selection/scoring, rewards, focus, evidence and action-gate semantics remain unchanged.

A verified strategic course/track label alone cannot justify a learning quest when current baseline, prerequisites, instruction/interface language, or concrete capability outcome is unknown or incompatible.
Zero-auth public PWA access, notifications, skills, marketplace presentation and non-learning execution actions remain intact.

tests.expected: The controller regression guard requires baseline/prerequisite/instruction-language/capability-outcome reconciliation for learning quests and rejects strategy-label-only suitability.
The corrected A0 German quest exposes the official Russian DW Hallo URL and the cancelled recovery quest is not the execution-action target.
Existing cloud/PWA quest, projection, focus, notification and public-access behavior remains green.

known_intentional_losses: The cancelled miscalibrated German recovery quest no longer receives a player-facing execution button.
